title: A New Classmate from Canada
passage:
Today was Lily's first day at a new school. She had just moved from Canada, and everything felt different. "Our classroom here is bigger than my old one," she said to her neighbor, Kevin. "But the weather is much hotter than in Canada!"
Kevin smiled. "You should bring a water bottle every day. It gets hotter in summer, so you must drink enough water."
During lunch, Lily looked nervous. "I don't know anyone here," she whispered.
"Don't worry," Kevin said kindly. "You shouldn't feel shy. Everyone is friendly, and I'm sure you'll make friends quickly."
At recess, Lily joined a basketball game with some classmates. She wasn't as skillful as the other players, but she tried her best and scored twice. "That was amazing!" her classmate Amy shouted. "You're almost as good as our team captain!"
After school, Lily and Kevin walked home together. "Taiwan is noisier than Canada, but I actually like it," Lily said. "The night markets are more exciting than anything near my old house."
"You should visit the one near my house this weekend," Kevin suggested. "It has the best dumplings in town."
Lily smiled brightly. "I'd love that. Thank you for being so kind today."
By the end of the day, Lily felt much happier than in the morning. She realized that making new friends wasn't as hard as she had expected. She couldn't wait to see her new classmates again tomorrow.

grammar: 比較級 (adj + -er / more + adj) + than：表示兩者程度不同的比較。例：Our classroom here is bigger than my old one. / The night markets are more exciting than anything near my old house.
as + 形容詞 + as（同等比較）／not as...as（不如）：表示兩者程度相同或不相同。例：You're almost as good as our team captain! / She wasn't as skillful as the other players.
should / shouldn't 表建議：should 表示「應該」，shouldn't 表示「不應該」，用來給建議或忠告。例：You should bring a water bottle every day. / You shouldn't feel shy.

opts: Much happier than in the morning
Ready to go back to Canada

opts: Our classroom here is big than my old one.
Our classroom here is bigger than my old one.
Our classroom here is more big than my old one.
Our classroom here is as big my old one.
grammar.ex: 比較級用「形容詞 + -er + than」，big 的比較級為 bigger，故選 B。

grammar.q: Choose the correct sentence using "more + adjective + than".
opts: The night markets are exciting than anything near my old house.
The night markets are more exciting than anything near my old house.
The night markets are most exciting than anything near my old house.
The night markets are more excited than anything near my old house.
grammar.ex: 多音節形容詞的比較級用「more + 形容詞 + than」，exciting 前應加 more，故選 B。

grammar.q: Choose the correct sentence with "as...as" for equal comparison.
opts: You're almost as good as our team captain.
You're almost as good than our team captain.
You're almost good as our team captain.
You're almost as well as our team captain.
grammar.ex: 同等比較用「as + 形容詞 + as」，故選 A。

grammar.q: Choose the correct sentence using "not as...as" (not equal).
opts: She wasn't as skillful than the other players.
She wasn't as skillful as the other players.
She wasn't so skillful the other players.
She wasn't skillful as the other players.
grammar.ex: 否定同等比較用「not as + 形容詞 + as」，故選 B。

grammar.q: Choose the correct sentence giving advice with "should/shouldn't".
opts: You should to bring a water bottle every day.
grammar.ex: should/shouldn't 後面接動詞原形，表建議，故選 B。
